abstention.label: JUSTIFIED
abstention.reason: The question asks whether applicants' goals are expected to meet or exceed New York State's 30% MWBE utilization goal. The retrieved passages establish only that ESD has an agency-wide 30% MWBE goal, SDVOB goals, possible contract-specific goals that may be higher or lower, and good-faith-effort/compliance requirements; they do not document the exact promise that applicants' own goals must meet or exceed 30%, so not saving a commitment was justified on this capture alone.
